intent: A tall tarnished-bronze crown-helm of uneven bone tines and a dark face mask over warm bronze-brown mail with green verdigris, a broad bronze collar holding a pale bone gorget and a mouldering moss cloak hung from one shoulder, so the high camera reads a pale crown over a bronze yoke and a green back.
reason: Barrow king: a bone-spike crown with moss overgrowth patches on bronze plate, all four brief colours together, the dug-up story told best (first critic 7.58, first; second critic 6.80, third).
first_fix: Re-base the metal to tarnished bronze, unify the dark-green back with the front, and use fewer, larger moss patches.
